def accepted_count(cap: int, n: int) -> int:
    """Number of sends accepted when n elements are sent without blocking to a channel of capacity cap."""
    pre cap >= 0
    pre n >= 0
    post out >= 0
    post out <= cap
    post out <= n
    ex accepted_count(2, 3) == 2
    ex accepted_count(5, 2) == 2
    ex accepted_count(0, 1) == 0
    ex accepted_count(3, 0) == 0
    if n < cap:
        return n
    return cap

def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Create an int channel with capacity cap, try to send each element of xs without blocking, and return how many sends were accepted before the channel was full."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0
    post out <= xs.len()
    post out <= cap
    return accepted_count(cap=cap, n=xs.len())
